The verifier requires the exact markers written verbatim: `**Situation:**`, `**Task:**`, `**Action:**`, `**Result:**`. Check that your headers match character for character — a missing asterisk or trailing space will fail the check.

The Result section must contain at least one digit. A sentence like 'reduced deploy time by 40%' or 'unblocked 3 engineers' passes. A sentence like 'things improved significantly' fails. If you do not have an exact figure, derive a reasonable estimate and state your assumption.

Use 'I', not 'we', in the Action section. The verifier does not check this, but the interviewer will. If you find yourself writing 'we', pause and name your specific step: not 'we debugged it' but 'I added structured logging to the retry path, which revealed the root cause in under 10 minutes'.
